slides.texte_overlay:
Signs you're becoming
a better man (even if
it doesn't feel like it)
You need less approval. You still enjoy compliments, but you no longer change your plans to please everyone.
You take care of things before they break. The dentist, the car, the money talk. Fixing small problems early is a sign of a grown man.
You listen more than you talk. In conversations you ask questions and remember the answers. People feel it.
You spend money more carefully. Fewer impulse buys, more saving for what matters. It feels like freedom, not like sacrifice.
Before: my evenings were all scrolling. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I feel myself growing again.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my evenings were all scrolling. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I feel myself growing again.

slides.texte_overlay: You forgive faster. You still remember what happened, but you no longer carry the anger around for months.
You're comfortable alone. A quiet evening, a solo walk, a meal by yourself. You enjoy your own company now.
